reviews.comment: This class was pretty easy! No textbook needed, all exams (3) were memorization, and the labs (10) were easy. The key to this class was showing up to the lab, which is vital because he teaches you everything that you'll need on those assignments. If you take notes and or get them, you'll be ready for the exam. He's also very caring and nice!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took him for SOCI220, Masa makes this class very laid back compared to things I've heard about other profs. Lectures are a bit dull but take notes word-for-word from the slides, study, and the tests will be pretty similar if not exact wordings. Assignments on excel once a week that aren't bad because he explains in class.

Masa was a super chill professor who also made this class accessible on Zoom, which made this course more relaxed. I had this class on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays at 8:00am. The GroupMe: everyone helped each other out, if someone was not able to log into Zoom by sharing notes. Test were heavily weighted on vocabulary from the lectures.

Masa is super nice. Be sure to study for exams and you'll be fine. His lectures aren't always the most engaging, but be sure to take notes. Content from the slides relate heavily to the exam material. Overall a nice professor for this class.

This is the hardest class I have ever taken at Texas A&M and I have taken Bio-chem. He makes this class much more difficult than it is. Get ready to study too much for his exams. He makes everything he assigns overcomplicated, it is ridiculous. Do yourself a favor and take it with a real professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy
